subject: Request: 2-week pilot extension + burst pricing options
message_1_subject: Pilot extension request + burst pricing for PoC
message_1_body:
Hi Logan / Kimberly,

Thanks for the run so far — the team has been able to validate the model accuracy and we are close on the integration. We do have one blocking item: our usage spiked last week while load-testing, and we’re likely to exceed the agreed hours before we finish the last two integration checkpoints.

Rather than cutting the pilot short, would Redwood consider a two-week extension (same scope) and a temporary burst pricing rate for extra concurrency during the final validation? We attached the usage report that shows the spike.

Questions:
- Can the extension be on the existing PO (C-2026-0842) as an addendum?
- If you can offer a burst rate, what would the incremental per-token / per-hour cost look like for ~250 burst hours?

We’re aiming to finish by mid-September if we can stabilize load. Appreciate a quick thumbs-up so we can unblock the infra team.

Best,
Ari Malhotra
Head of ML Ops, CobaltAI
Ari.Malhotra@cobaltai.com

Attachment: pilot_usage_summary.csv (CSV, 45 KB)
message_2_subject: Re: Pilot extension request + burst pricing for PoC
message_2_body:
Ari — thanks for sending this over and congrats to the team on progress. Quick responses inline: 

1) Extension: yes — we can do a 2-week extension as an addendum to C-2026-0842. I’ll draft the simple addendum and send to Jin for signature if that works.

2) Burst pricing: two options we often use that might fit your scenario:
   - Option A (timebox top-up): pay for 250 burst hours at a discounted token rate — in practice this is a fixed chunk billed upfront; unit economics similar to a 10% discount vs pay-as-you-go.
   - Option B (temporary rate card uplift): extend the pilot and allow burst at an explicit per-hour uplift (approx +18% on the hosted per-token rate) — runs only for the two-week window.

To move quickly, I’ll need confirmation of which option (A or B) you prefer, and whether finance wants the addendum on the original PO or a separate invoice.

I’ve cc’d Kimberly (pricing) and Vanessa (operations) to confirm internal approvals and any capacity reservations we should make.

I’ll attach a short proposal with estimated costs for both options in a follow-up.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
T: +1 415-555-0182
message_3_subject: Re: Pilot extension request + burst pricing for PoC
message_3_body:
Thanks — dug into the numbers from the CSV. Quick guidance from pricing/finance: 

- Option A (250-hour top-up): total incremental charge = $28,500. We can offer a 12% discount if the addendum is executed on the existing PO (C-2026-0842) and invoiced this month.
- Option B (per-hour uplift): estimated impact for your expected burst is ~ $33k over two weeks. This gives you flexibility to only consume what you need but costs slightly more if you use the whole allowance.

Given you’re close to completion, Option A is cleaner (fixed cost, simpler acceptance) and we can add one operational concession: waive the late-burst surcharge if you keep within the extended window and share the final runbook post-run.

Vanessa — can you confirm we have the capacity to reserve a small burst pool for Ari the week of 9/6?

Ari — if you’re OK with Option A + 12% discount, I’ll prep a short addendum and route to your PO contact. If you prefer Option B, say so and I’ll draft an estimate for the per-hour uplift route.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
message_4_subject: Re: Pilot extension request + burst pricing for PoC
message_4_body:
Logan / Kimberly — thanks for the fast turnaround. We’ll take Option A (250-hour top-up) with the 12% discount and the waived late-burst surcharge (assuming the window is respected). Please route the addendum to our procurement contact (cc’d Jin).

Two small asks from our side before signatures:
- Can you include a short clause that explicitly ties the burst hours to the two-week extension window and confirms no additional entitlement beyond that?
- Can Redwood provide the invoice to our AP with the existing PO number on it? (PO: C-2026-0842)

If you can get the addendum to us by end of day tomorrow we’ll sign and route it internally. Appreciate the flexibility — this keeps the timeline intact.

Thanks,
Ari
